coverage: Seven-day cutoff survives a restart; months-long live conversations stay active
Recent completion, stopped coordinators, and tripped guards prevent retirement
Unproven sends prevent retirement after their turn is superseded
Exact sweep retires once, preserves history, cancels timers, and recreates one coordinator
New live work cancels retirement; stale background-job claims cannot stop the Agent
Installation and binding remain until the monitored owner is proven down
Archived late replies remain consumed events without resetting inactivity

limits: The inactivity interval was accelerated locally, not observed for seven production days
The sweep and recreation use exact job authority; owner-down uses the existing monitored lifecycle fixture
This does not prove whole-BEAM recovery or every runtime health criterion
